description: Unit tests for the DecodeBuffer class in the quiche HTTP/2 implementation, testing decoding of integers, buffer behavior, and error conditions.

classes.name: DecodeBufferTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for DecodeBuffer unit tests, includes random generator and decode offset.

methods.name: DecodesFixedInts
methods.description: Tests decoding of fixed-size integers from the buffer.

methods.name: HasNotCopiedInput
methods.description: Verifies that DecodeBuffer does not copy input data, only points into it.

methods.name: DecodeBufferSubsetLimited
methods.description: Tests that DecodeBufferSubset cannot go beyond the base buffer size.

methods.name: DecodeBufferSubsetAdvancesCursor
methods.description: Checks that DecodeBufferSubset advances the base cursor upon destruction.
